outbreak_frequency: NA for Kampala itself; paper cites prior Uganda outbreaks in Kasese District (2007-2009, 8092 cases) and Kasese/Bundibugyo (2009-2011) as comparators, not Kampala history
notes: No routine typhoid surveillance existed pre-outbreak in Kampala; >200 unprotected groundwater sources sustain recurrent contamination; mass vaccination floated as future option, not implemented
